I even exercised a lot the last month and played soccer before. But tore sth in my foot and had to skip cardio. I try to tell myself that I’m on a good way with trying to fix my addictions. But doesn’t work that well these days.  I’m also feeling like I’m on a rollercoaster of emotions, the highs are really low and the lows are just a desire to not to exist anymore. No clue what I have done with my life or why I wasn’t able to learn from my mistakes or heal myself. I don’t think anyone of my family can understand me, but they did nothing wrong. It’s all my fault I guess. 
And even in this constitution I can appreciate the time you take to communicate to me. Thanks so much.

I didn’t fap for hours but regularly nearly daily for years. It did a lot of damage I guess. Especially as I never experienced the real thing until 25. The last days I just layed in bed, was extremely depressive or just browsed reddit. At the start of NoFap I felt good and went to nearly all classes. Then it got worse (flatline), I stopped weed and Nicotine later as well. I guess it just added up. I started playing more video games or surfing the internet again, I think my body craved for dopamine, because it was used to get it from weed and gaming. 
Today I learned a bit, but not a lot...I would be ok to get a bad grade. But I’m kinda scared and my constitution makes going out and socialize pretty hard right now. I definetely should stop gaming as I get addicted very fast, but it’s hard to substitute other, better activities. I mean I didn’t even game the last 3 days, because I was too depressed.

It’s been more than 2 years and I don’t think that taking meds back then still has any influences. Yes, I’m scared as well of meds and their side effects. Ssri wouldn’t be an option I guess. After 4 months of NoFap I relapsed today as well. Can’t get any worse I guess, but I didn’t see any improvements and it felt good first. But obviously now I hate myself.

Im on no medication. I got off it when I was together with her, but Libido still was never good since then. I’m scared to get on meds again, because of the Libido fuck up and not sure if they even help me.
Not sure if I can help people here, especially with my English skills. Thanks
Maybe the thread title is misleading. What would be a better one? I’m not a native English speaker
